⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The LG electric dryer runs a full cycle with cold air, or flashes d80, d90, d95, or tE1 on the display.

Verified technical root cause: Restricted exhaust vent backpressure tripped the non-resettable 6931EL3003D high-limit thermal fuse on the heater housing or burned out the 5301EL1001J heating element.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Disconnect the dryer vent hose from the back of the dryer and clean out all lint buildup in your wall duct (d80/d90 means 80–90% exhaust blockage, which blows the 6931EL3003D thermal fuse).
  2. Test the 6931EL3003D thermal fuse mounted on the silver heater canister for continuity—if open, replace the fuse and thermostat kit.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (No Heat / Error d80 / d90 / d95 / tE1)

Can you reset the 6931EL3003D thermal fuse on an LG dryer?
No, 6931EL3003D is a one-time safety cut-off fuse and must be replaced once it trips.
